message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-400", "class": "InputStreamHelper", "method": "writeStreamToTempFile", "explanation": "The method copies the entire InputStream into a temporary file without enforcing any maximum size limit. An attacker who can supply or influence the InputStream can cause unbounded disk consumption, potentially exhausting the filesystem and causing denial of service."}, {"cwe": "CWE-409", "class": "InputStreamHelper", "method": "processZipStream", "explanation": "The ZIP extraction loop reads and writes every ZipEntry to disk without checking the number of entries or the uncompressed size of the entry or archive. This allows a zip bomb to exhaust disk space and cause a denial of service when processing a malicious archive."}, {"cwe": "CWE-378", "class": "InputStreamHelper", "method": "writeStreamToTempFile", "explanation": "The method creates the temporary file with File.createTempFile and then writes the input stream to it without setting restrictive file permissions. The file is created in the default shared temporary directory and may be world-readable (e.g., 0644 depending on umask), exposing any sensitive schedule data contained in the stream to other local users."}]}
